notes: - The game can now automatically check for and install updates - Added a toggle to always scroll to the entered Pokémon, regardless of whether it’s already guessed - After pressing Give Up, guessed Pokémon are marked with a green border and unguessed ones with a red circle - The final results dialog now includes a close (×) button and remains open until manually dismissed - Added toggle and volume slider for background music (with seamless carry-over between scenes) - A sound plays when a correct guess is made, and a different one when guessing an already-entered Pokémon - Buttons now react visually when hovered over with the mouse - The game executable now has a Poké Ball icon.
